Commentary.Commentary: We are back for India's reply. Bangladesh Women players stride out to the middle. Followed by Smriti Mandhana and Shafali Verma who walk out to open for India Women. It will be Sultana Khatun to start with the new ball.
... The Run Chase ...

As far as India are concerned it was not an impressive outing with the ball. The seamers could not really do any damage up top, and then Harmanpreet Kaur tried to get a spinner into the equation, it helped for slowing the run flow, but could not really threaten for wickets. Eventually, it was Sneh Rana who drew first blood in the 27th over but after that the next wicket came in the 41st over. Sneh Rana stood out with the ball in terms of wickets taken. Although, Deepti Sharma was very impressive after an economical spell. Well then, this tells you that it would be an enticing chase for the series decider. Can the Bangladesh Women bowlers do what the Indians could not? Or will the visitors put their best foot forward during the chase? We shall find out soon, as the run chase is coming up shortly...

The Bangladesh Women batters have backed their skipper's decision of batting first. Despite of being tested early on with the new ball, the new opening pair of Shamima Sultana and Fargana Hoque soaked all the pressure, stayed calm and took their time to get their eye-in. The pair had to work really hard to get runs on the board, as they could not find plenty of boundries in the opening 10 overs, they certainly grinded by running hard between the wickets. Soon after Shamima Sultana made her half-century she slipped out and that brought an end to this wonderful 93-run stand which set the tone of this innings. The skipper then came to the crease and made her intention pretty clear and so did Fargana Hoque as she upped her ante as well. The pair added some valuable runs in a short time - 71 runs off 85 balls to be precise. Although, once we entered the final 10 overs, the pair tried to showcase their aggressive approach, although it did not go right for the skipper as she walked back beacuse of a false shot. Nevertheless, Fargana Hoque stuck around and since the get go and made a remarkable ton in tough conditions. She also became the first ever Bangladesh Women player to score a century in a 50-over match. So by that, you are currently seeing the highest run scorer for Bangladesh Women in this format.

What a performance this has been from the hosts. The Bangladeshi batters certainly brought their A-game in this series decider. They had never won an ODI game against India Women, but they chalked it off in the first match of the series and certainly mean business on this final encounter.

OUT! RUN OUT! Fargana Hoque departs on the last delivery of the innings. Bangladesh Women have got to a good total of 225 and Fargana Hoque would be proud of her effort. A fuller delivery on off. Sobhana Mostary drives it left of the bowler. Shafali Verma initially stops it with the boot as Sobhana Mostary takes off for a single. Fargana Hoque is late to react but goes for the run. Verma though collects the ball quickly and fires a direct throw at the batter's end to run out the centurion on the last ball of the innings.
